label: Hg pen-lamp (calibration)

diameter.help: emit face diameter (circular) or edge length (rectangular, round_flag=0)

tooltip: Mercury pencil (pen) calibration lamp: discrete emission lines (spectrum=hg_penlamp) at the standard 11-line Hg pen-lamp set (253.65nm and 365.01nm strongest; see the emitters.miesrc row for the full list + NIST ASD citation). lambdac=435.83nm (the strong visible blue-violet line) is a representative wavelength; the spectrum table supersedes it for actual line sampling.
